meta.name: story-deslop
meta.description: 网文去AI味。检测并清除文本中的AI写作痕迹，让文字回归自然、非模板化。触发方式：/story-deslop、/去AI味、「去AI味」「这篇太AI了」「网文去AI味」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 去除网文AI腔调，让文字回归自然流畅
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果写网文时总担心文字有AI味
copy.tagline_en: Remove AI-flavored phrasing from web novels for natural writing
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write web novels and worry they sound AI-generated.

howto.what: 先扫出文本里的 AI 味位置，再把过于工整、书面、解释太满的句子改成口语化、带停顿的白话；保留剧情与人设，只改“怎么说”不改“说什么”，按轻重限制删改幅度，输出前后对比报告。
howto.when: 当你说出“去AI味”“这篇太AI了”等词，或用 /story-deslop 等命令时触发；若要求只检测不加修改，则只出问题标记表不改原文。

say.text: 这段话太AI了，帮我改自然一点。
say.note: 执行完整检测与润色，输出修改前后对比。

say.text: 检查一下这段有没有AI味，先别改。
say.note: 只出检测报告，不修改原文。

say.text: 润色这段，剧情和人设不要动。
say.note: 先检测再按级别润色，保留情节与人设。

howto.what_en: Scans for AI-tinged spots, then rewrites bookish, over-neat, over-explained lines into colloquial writing with concrete actions. Keeps plot and characters, limits deletions by severity, and reports edits.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you use commands like /story-deslop or say phrases such as "去AI味" or "这篇太AI了". If you ask for detection only, it returns a problem report without editing.

say_en.text: This passage sounds too AI-written. Make it more natural.
say_en.note: Runs full scan and polish, then shows before/after.

say_en.text: Check if this passage has an AI flavor, but don't edit it.
say_en.note: Returns an issue report only; no changes to the text.

say_en.text: Polish this passage, keep the plot and characters unchanged.
say_en.note: Detects first, then edits within the allowed limit.
